mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and thus negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate activity, as measured by housing starts, over a 3-month period signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals supply chain disruptions or weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and the CPI is increasing by more than 0.5% month-over-month, the combination signals inflationary pressure and tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls by more than 100,000 in a month signals weakening labor market conditions, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and thus negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth is positive but the unemployment rate is rising, it indicates a mismatch between economic growth and labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 positive growth and UNRATE rising
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.
